arguments.query: SELECT status, count(*), min(order_ts), max(order_ts) FROM orders GROUP BY status
SELECT region_code, count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY region_code
SELECT payment_status, count(*), sum(amount_twd) FROM payments GROUP BY payment_status
SELECT o.status, p.payment_status, count(*), count(distinct o.order_id), sum(p.amount_twd) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1,2
SELECT o.status, count(*), sum(r.refund_amount_twd) FROM orders o JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY 1
SELECT o.status, count(*) FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id=o.order_id WHERE s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

SELECT c.region_code, count(*), sum(p.amount_twd)*1.0/count(*) aov_ok, sum(CASE WHEN o.status=3 THEN p.amount_twd END)*1.0/sum(o.status=3) aov3 FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.order_id AND p.payment_status='ok' WHERE o.order_ts>='2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts<'2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3

SELECT c.region_code, sum(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents)/100.0/count(distinct o.order_id) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status=3 AND o.order_ts>='2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts<'2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2
SELECT count(*) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id IS NULL
